section_1_complete_textbook_notes.chapter_overview: This chapter covers equal sharing, fractional units 1/n, numerators and denominators, fraction wall visualization, equivalent fractions, proper/improper/mixed fractions, number line placement, and Brahmagupta's ancient general rules (628 CE) for fraction addition and subtraction.

detailed_sections.section_number_title: 7.1 Concept of Fractions and Fractional Units
detailed_sections.full_textbook_explanation: A fraction represents equal parts of a whole unit. Unit fraction 1/n represents one part when 1 whole is divided into n equal parts. As denominator n increases, unit fraction size 1/n decreases (1/8 < 1/3).

mathematical_definitions.formal_definition: A fraction with a numerator of 1, representing one equal part of a whole.

detailed_sections.full_textbook_explanation:
Equivalent fractions represent equal quantitative proportions. Brahmagupta (628 CE) formulated general addition and subtraction rules by converting to common fractional units:
Addition: a/b + c/d = (a.d + b.c) / (b.d)
Subtraction: a/b - c/d = (a.d - b.c) / (b.d).

mathematical_definitions.formal_definition: Fractions that represent identical values or proportions.

formulas_and_properties.name: Brahmagupta's Addition Rule
formulas_and_properties.variable_definitions: a, b, c, d = integers, b, d != 0

fraction_scalar_mastery.explanation: Multiplying a fraction by a whole number scales the numerator: k * (a/b) = (k*a)/b. Multi-stage word problems track remaining fractional balances sequentially.

section_2_step_by_step_algorithms.method_name: Converting Mixed Fractions to Improper Fractions
step_by_step_instructions: Step 1: Multiply whole integer part by denominator.
Step 3: Write sum over original denominator: (Whole x Denom + Num) / Denom.
